description: Refreshes every lock on the branch that moves the pin, so the pull request arrives loadable. Self-hosted Renovate only: the hosted app runs no post-upgrade command.
For a repository that includes the tasklib module in Taskfile.dev.yaml, the root its gates run from. renovate/tasklib-lock is the same for Taskfile.yaml.

The command below has to be in Renovate's allowedCommands, and `task` has to be where Renovate runs it — inside its container, under renovatebot/github-action. A command missing from the allow-list is skipped with a log line, and nothing turns red.
